title: Corollary 9.4: separatedness under closed-immersion gluing
statement_scope: Suppose given a pushout diagram of spectral Deligne-Mumford stacks X01→X0, X01→X1, X0→X, X1→X, where i and j are closed immersions. If X0 and X1 are separated spectral algebraic spaces, then X is a separated spectral algebraic space. Complete statement and proof retained.
difficulty_reason: Rule author-work-bearing-core-v1-20261114: the unit gives a concrete non-routine derivation of separatedness from the closed-immersion gluing theorem, reducing closedness of the diagonal δ to closedness of the three vertical maps and factoring δ0 through X0×X0 (statement and proof, physical page 51). This is above routine checking but is a corollary of the H3 Proposition 9.3.

difficulty_evidence.bearing_core: Separatedness of the glued stack from separatedness of X0 and X1 via the diagonal and Proposition 9.3.
